description: This shell script contains a series of test cases for Git-P4 integration, specifically testing file types, encoding handling, newline conversion, symbolic links, keyword expansion, and other integration features between Git and Perforce. It defines multiple test scenarios to verify correct behavior in handling different file formats, encodings, and special cases.
calls: test_expect_success 'ensure blobs store only lf newlines' ' ... '
test_expect_success 'gitattributes setting eol=lf produces lf newlines' ' ... '
test_expect_success 'gitattributes setting eol=crlf produces crlf newlines' ' ... '
test_expect_success SYMLINKS 'ensure p4 symlink parsed correctly' ' ... '
test_expect_success SYMLINKS 'utf-8 with and without BOM in text file' ' ... '
